2%

TRANSFER TAX

Every buy and sell on the pair is taxed 2%: 1% to operations (in BNB) and 1% to LP that is burned. Regular wallet-to-wallet transfers are not taxed.

5%

POOL A FEE & CLAIM FEE

Pool A principal returns are charged a 5% fee (BNB). Every reward claim is charged 5% (VEIN). Pool B has no principal fee — proceeds return as VEIN + BNB from the LP.

99%

SNIPE TAX — ONE TIME ONLY

In the opening block of trading, sniper bots are taxed 99%. After that block, the tax returns to the normal 2% for everyone.

Honest note: $0.0001 is the initial sale price, not a price floor. Once trading begins, the price moves freely with the contents of the pair — there is no buyback or reserve fund holding it up.

▦ HOW IT WORKS & RULES

FOUR PULSES FROM BUYING TO HARVEST
01

BUY $VEIN

Agent ID holders buy VEIN at the fixed price of $0.0001 — minimum ±$1, maximum 5 BNB per wallet, no time limit.

02

LP IS FORMED

When all 200M VEIN are sold, all BNB from the sale + the 150M VEIN liquidity allocation become permanent LP on PancakeSwap.

03

POOLS START PULSING

Pool A & Pool B open. Deposit BNB per share (max 10 / Agent ID); positions are recorded in the contract with no NFT.

04

MINE & CLAIM

Pool A: claim + principal back after 24 hours. Pool B: VEIN + BNB proceeds vest gradually over 14 days.

TOKEN SALE +
  • Fixed price of $0.0001 per VEIN. Reference rate: 0.001 BNB ≈ 6,874 VEIN (follows the BNB price at the time of purchase).
  • Sale allocation of 200,000,000 VEIN (20% of supply). No time limit — the sale runs until the allocation is gone.
  • Only wallets holding an Agent ID can buy. Minimum ±$1 (±0.0015 BNB), maximum 5 BNB per wallet.
  • All sale proceeds go into permanent LP, not to the team.
POOL A — FAST PULSE +
  • Deposit 0.001 BNB per share, maximum 10 shares per Agent ID. Epoch 1 reward: 750 VEIN per share.
  • After 24 hours: claim your VEIN rewards and take your principal back, minus a 5% fee.
  • Example per share: deposit 0.001 BNB → receive 750 VEIN + 0.00095 BNB back.
POOL B — LP PULSE +
  • Deposit 0.001 BNB per share, maximum 10 shares per Agent ID. Epoch 1 reward: 2,500 VEIN per share.
  • From your deposit: half buys VEIN, half is paired as liquidity.
  • Your proceeds — VEIN + your BNB share of the LP — vest linearly over 14 days, calculated second by second from the moment you deposit.
HALVING & SUPPLY +
  • Fixed total supply of 1,000,000,000 VEIN: mining 50% · sale 20% · liquidity 15% · team 10% · community 5%.
  • The 500M VEIN mining allocation is paid out gradually. The base reward halves every 150,000 shares combined across both pools — once the mining allocation is exhausted, there are no new rewards.
  • Team allocation: 20% TGE unlock at launch for operations, 80% vesting linearly over 6 months (±13.3M VEIN / month).
REFERRAL +
  • A reward of 1,000 VEIN per referral — flat for everyone, no tiers.
  • A referral qualifies only after the invited wallet has staked / mined 2× in Pool A or Pool B.
  • Rewards are paid from the Community allocation (50M VEIN) — enough for 50,000 qualified referrals.
FEES & TAXES +
  • 2% transfer tax on buys and sells on the pair: 1% operations (BNB) + 1% LP that is burned.
  • 5% Pool A fee on returned principal · 5% claim fee on claimed VEIN.
  • 99% snipe tax in the opening block of trading only.
  • Token sale proceeds are not team income — 100% becomes LP.
